statement: Bring content into the document in the asset system with "Download Asset"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Bring content into the document in the asset system with "Download Assets"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in the asset system with "Assign Action"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Bring content into the document in the asset system with "Open File Location"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.
Copy content in the asset system with "Copy to Asset Library"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.

Remove or clear content in the asset system with "Delete Asset Catalog"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in the asset system with "New Asset Catalog"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
Run the action "Redo Catalog Edits" in the asset system; the document or playback state ends as Blender 5.3 leaves it for the same input, and the user can cancel or undo it.
Run the action "Undo Catalog Edits" in the asset system; the document or playback state ends as Blender 5.3 leaves it for the same input, and the user can cancel or undo it.
Use "Store undo snapshot for asset catalog edits" in the asset system; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.
Write document content to disk or pack it into the file in the asset system with "Save Asset Catalogs"; reading it back reproduces the same content, and failures leave the previous file intact.
